Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning state tax incentives to encourage the redevelopment of port district property.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state tax incentives to encourage theredevelopment of port district property; adding a new section tochapter 82.04 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.14 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 82.29A RCW; providing an effective date; andproviding expiration dates.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Persons subject to payment of the tax under this chapter maydeduct any amounts received for the following activities occurringwithin a port district business redevelopment zone: (a) Making sales at retail or wholesale; (b) Manufacturing or processing for hire; or (c) Performing any service. (2) For the purpose of this section, "port district businessredevelopment zone" has the same meaning as provided in section 3 ofthis act. (3) This section expires January 1, 2025.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.14 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A city legislative authority may fix and impose a sales and usetax in accordance with the terms of this chapter for the purposesdesignated in subsection (3) of this section. (2) The tax authorized in this section must be deducted from theamount of tax otherwise required to be collected or paid over to thedepartment under chapter 82.08 or 82.12 RCW. The rate of tax may notexceed onetenth of one percent of the selling price in the case ofsales tax, or value of the article used, in the case of a use tax. (3) Moneys received from any tax imposed under this section must beused solely for the purpose of public improvement costs within a portdistrict business redevelopment zone. (4) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection. (a) "Port district business redevelopment zone" has the samemeaning as provided in section 3 of this act. (b) "Public improvement costs" has the same meaning as provided inRCW 39.102.020. (5) This section expires January 1, 2025.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.29A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The leasehold excise tax under RCW 82.29A.030 does not apply toleasehold interests in real or personal property located within a portdistrict business redevelopment zone. (2) The exemption provided in subsection (1) of this section doesnot apply to city and county leasehold excise taxes imposed under RCW82.29A.040. (3) For the purposes of this section, "port district businessredevelopment zone" means any area: (a) Acquired by a port district with a population of one millionfive hundred thousand or more for the purpose of airport expansion oraircraft noise mitigation, and the area is currently designated by acity for redevelopment for business or commercial uses; (b) Any area owned by the state of Washington as of January 1,2010, and located adjacent to an area described under (a) of thissubsection; and SB 6560 p. 2 (c) Any area within one thousand seven hundred fifty feet of theboundary of an area described in (a) or (b) of this subsection. (4) This section expires January 1, 2025.
